text: Claim C-1076 scores 14.5 of 100 (Medium band), with 88.6% of rule points backed by data, and the score is driven mainly by BI-2 Medical build-up (12 points, treatment growth to many times the usual amount with near-daily visits), plus BI-3 Mostly subjective findings (8 points, imaging and standard tests within normal limits with findings resting mainly on pain reports), BI-6 Heavy early treatment (8 points, 15 visits in the first 30 days after the 2023-09-26 loss), and BF-1 Fast reserve rise (8 points, reserve rising from 9,525.41 on 2023-10-09 to 22,949.42 on 2023-10-29). These rules show an unusual pattern that may be a possible link to fraud, but they do not establish it, and the claim needs human review. The reviewer should first check the treatment growth and visit frequency in the adjuster file against the medical records, since that single pattern accounts for the largest share of points, and confirm whether the clinical rationale for the visit volume is documented.
